scope: Opt-in Go environment controller and real local cmd terminals; managed project copies only; production backend unchanged

reproduction.precondition: Build the candidate BoundaryProbe.exe; set CAGE_TEST_APPCONTAINER_LAUNCHER to its absolute path; ordinary host execution permissions required

limitations: Environment APIs are not yet connected to the production backend or a complete workbench user flow.
The two terminals intentionally share one environment identity and its explicitly imported projects; this is not per-terminal project isolation.
Projects are managed copies, not live host folders. Import/export requires all environment terminals to have stopped.

Copies preserve regular unnamed file contents and directory structure; they reject junctions, symlinks and hard-linked files rather than preserving them. Alternate streams and original metadata are not copied.
A failed copy retains its partial new destination for inspection; it does not overwrite or automatically remove an existing host destination.
This test uses cmd and a small copied batch tool. Browser, editor and Claude application compatibility is separate evidence.
The test confirms profile and data survival across controller Close/Open, then explicitly deletes only its dedicated test profile. Production controller Close retains the profile and data.
This is offline ordinary AppContainer evidence, not LPAC, production proxy/DNS integration, VM isolation or a complete host resource audit.
